description:
Creates or overwrites a file at the specified path. Use this tool to create a new file or to replace the whole contents of an existing one. If the destination file already exists, you MUST first read it before writing, so that you know what the write replaces. For a targeted change to an existing file, prefer StrReplace.

Usage:
- The directories on the way to the file are created when they do not exist.
- contents is written exactly as given, as the whole file. It holds at most {write_limit} bytes.
- A path that names a directory fails.
- The calls in one response that change files run one after another, in the order you list them.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to write

contents.description: The contents to write to the file
